scope: Operational CPU environment and byte-transfer preparation only; no scientific computation or GPU job submission

authentication_correction.previous_assessment: A temporary automatic authentication redirect was incorrectly treated as requiring user intervention
authentication_correction.current_observation: The existing Chrome Incognito My Interactive Sessions page shows Logged in as xy3257; previous sessions are Completed
authentication_correction.interpretation: Existing SSO is usable for normal session navigation; no new login is required by this observation
authentication_correction.if_an_actual_new_authentication_challeng: Stop and let the user complete authentication personally

cpu_interactive_session.source: Values observed in the current HPC Jupyter form before submission
cpu_interactive_session.actual_allocation: Verify native allocation, identity, cwd and scratch location after connection; form settings alone are not execution proof

remote_filesystem.root_rule: Choose a previously nonexistent directory beneath the current user's verified scratch location after checking pwd and identity
remote_filesystem.insufficient_space_or_quota: Stop and report; do not delete files

git_preparation.method: Shallow single-branch git clone into the new personal scratch directory
git_preparation.expected_head: Record the deployment registration commit after it is committed and pushed, then require the remote checkout HEAD to match that exact commit

dataset_transfer.content: Only the already generated observation/evaluation NPZ byte streams named in the frozen manifest
dataset_transfer.packing: ZIP_STORED; verify each NPZ SHA256 without decompressing its arrays
dataset_transfer.remote_manifest_source: The exact tracked manifest from the verified Git checkout; verify its SHA256 before unpacking
dataset_transfer.output_directory_rule: Create this directory only after committing and pushing this registration; it must not already exist
dataset_transfer.unpack_rule: Require archive SHA256 from the local pack receipt, the exact 2432-member allowlist, and all individual SHA256 matches before creating new destination NPZ files

dependency_preparation.target_torch: 2.5.1, with an official CUDA local-version suffix allowed
allowed_actions: Install the registered Python and dependency versions
Read versions and perform dependency/import availability checks
Record preparation receipts and installed package versions
disallowed_actions: Open test observations or test features
dependency_preparation.old_phase2_environment_helper: Do not execute unchanged: it targets Python 3.11 and an unrelated Phase 2 package set
dependency_preparation.cache_constraint: The frozen scientific runner chooses its own new output cache paths; do not precreate its output directory or override its registered cache behavior
dependency_preparation.environment_error: Stop and report the exact error; do not change pins, use another Python version, or alter the scientific protocol to bypass it

future_gpu_execution.submission_parameters: To be checked and separately registered before any submission; this file does not invent a GPU partition or wrapper

stop_conditions: An actual authentication challenge requires the user
Current identity, cwd, scratch ownership or native allocation cannot be verified
Git HEAD, committed file, source, manifest, archive or NPZ hash mismatch
Any unexpected split, archive entry, pre-existing output or artifact destination
Environment installation, package-version or dependency-check error
Any preparation action would change the frozen scientific protocol or access test data
